title: Tide Together Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Tide Together, Seaside, Florida- three king primary suites on Ruskin Park, within walking distance to the beach and downtown. Lovely townhome, with multiple balconies, outdoor dining, and a roof top deck with incredible town and gulf views!
description_expanded: Description203 EAST RUSKIN PLACE3 KINGS, 2 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFAS (sleeps 10) Luxury Four-Story Townhome in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaEscape to coastal elegance in this stunning four-story luxury townhome overlooking picturesque Ruskin Park in Seaside, Florida. Located just 352 yards from Seaside’s sugar-white sand beaches and turquoise Gulf waters, this New Orleans–inspired retreat seamlessly blends timeless architecture with modern coastal comfort. Designed for relaxation and unforgettable sunsets, the home features three king bedrooms with private ensuite baths, multiple balconies, outdoor dining spaces, and a breathtaking rooftop deck with sweeping Gulf views.Thoughtful Architectural Design by Alexander GorlinStep inside and experience the distinctive vision of renowned New York architect Alexander Gorlin, whose coastal aesthetic and attention to detail are showcased throughout the home. The first floor features two serene king bedrooms, each equipped with a smart HDTV and a private ensuite bathroom with glass-enclosed walk-in showers. One bedroom opens directly onto Ruskin Park through charming double doors, creating a peaceful, storybook-style retreat in the heart of Seaside.Open-Concept Living, Dining & Kitchen on the Second FloorThe second floor opens into a bright, light-filled living space thoughtfully styled with designer furnishings and coastal décor. A newly added queen sleeper sofa allows for additional guests, while a 65” Smart HDTV anchors the living area. Double French doors lead to a balcony overlooking Ruskin Park—perfect for morning coffee or evening people-watching. Adjacent to the living room is a cozy card table for game nights, a formal dining area seating six, and a fully updated kitchen featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast nook for four. Just beyond the kitchen, enjoy a private open-air porch with outdoor dining for six, offering treetop and town views ideal for long coastal evenings. A convenient half bath is also located on this level.Expansive Primary Suite & Private Living AreaThe third floor is dedicated to the expansive king primary suite and a secondary private living area. This additional lounge features a queen sleeper sofa, large flat-screen TV, and access to a private balcony with Adirondack chaise loungers overlooking Ruskin Park—an ideal escape for reading or relaxing with a glass of wine. The adjacent king primary suite includes a smart HDTV, ample closet space, and its own private balcony with Adirondack seating. The ensuite bath is sleek and modern, complete with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower and stylish vanity, creating a true luxury hideaway.Rooftop Deck with Panoramic Gulf & Seaside ViewsAt the very top of the home, a glass-enclosed tower leads to the crown jewel—the rooftop deck. This elevated oasis is outfitted with a wet bar, desk area for remote work, chaise loungers, and Adirondack seating. Enjoy 360-degree views of Seaside’s colorful rooftops, the sparkling Gulf of Mexico, and unforgettable sunsets. Whether you’re sipping cocktails at golden hour or stargazing under the night sky, this rooftop experience is simply unmatched.An Unforgettable Seaside Vacation RentalThis exceptional Seaside townhome offers the perfect blend of architectural charm, modern luxury, walkable beach access, and iconic views. Located in the heart of Seaside, Florida, overlooking Ruskin Park and just steps from the beach, this home is an extraordinary coastal escape designed for both relaxation and memorable moments.* 5 night minimum Spring Break & Summer; 3 night minimum Spring & Fall; 3 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. FEATURES3,098 square feet of thoughtfully designed luxury living space4-minute walk (352 yards) to Seaside’s sugar-white sand beach accessAccess to the Seaside Private Residential Beach at East Ruskin Pavilion, one of the largest private residential beaches along Scenic Highway 30A1 GB high-speed internet available throughout the homeYouTube TV with Live TV access provided by the ownerMultiple private balconies, outdoor dining on the rear porch, and a rooftop deck with Gulf viewsPrivate covered parking for two vehicles in the on-site carportDedicated laundry room with full-size washer and dryerOutdoor shower for convenient post-beach rinsesPeacock Alley linens, featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and plush towels throughout the homeAccess to 3 community swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote including two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedGolf cart policy: Golf carts are considered vehicles and are not permitted for non-homeowners in Seaside. Special circumstances or medical needs require an approved golf cart permitNo pets allowed STR23-002373
